verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that 1Password stores one-time passwords and offers a CLI, SDKs and a Connect REST API for managing items. No evidence item documents generating or returning a current TOTP code through any of these surfaces, such as a CLI flag or an API/SDK OTP field. Storage plus general item access is adjacent support, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
